title: Roblox Account Verification
description: Welcome to the Springfield Fire Department Discord. Link your Roblox account to receive the verified member role and access the appropriate department channels.
instructions: Enter your Roblox username in the private form.
Copy the temporary code into your Roblox profile description.
Return to Discord and select Check Verification.
privacy_notice: Your code is shown privately and expires automatically. Never share your Roblox password, session cookie or login details with anyone.
